hooks.name: Keep the specs in step with the code
hooks.description: When server or domain code changes, checks that the EARS requirements and task lists still describe what the code does, and that every requirement is still named by a test.

action.prompt: You just changed behavior under src/. Compare the change with .kiro/specs/missed-call-booking/requirements.md and .kiro/specs/voice-invoicing/requirements.md. If the code now does something no EARS criterion describes, add a numbered criterion (WHEN/IF/WHILE ... THE SYSTEM SHALL ...) and a checked task in that spec's tasks.md. Name the criterion in the title of the test that proves it, as [MC x.y] or [VI x.y]. Then run `npm run spec:coverage` and fix anything it reports.
